description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshQuota查询当天URL刷新、目录刷新、预热及封禁的最大限制数量和剩余量
name: DescribeRefreshQuota

BlockQuota.description_en: The maximum number of URLs that can be refreshed on the current day

BlockRemain.description_en: The remaining number of times that you can prefetch content to L2 points of presence (POPs) on the current day

DirQuota.description_zh: 当天目录刷新数量上限

DirRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be refreshed on the current day
DirRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余目录刷新数量

IgnoreParamsQuota.description_en: The maximum number of URLs or directories with parameters ignored that can be refreshed on the current day
IgnoreParamsQuota.description_zh: 当天忽略参数刷新数量上限

IgnoreParamsRemain.description_en: The number of remaining URLs or directories that can be refreshed with parameters ignored on the current day
IgnoreParamsRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余忽略参数刷新数量

PreloadEdgeQuota.description_en: The maximum number of directories that can be refreshed on the current day
PreloadEdgeQuota.description_zh: 当天L1节点预热数量上限

PreloadEdgeRemain.description_en: The maximum number of times that you can prefetch content to L1 POPs on the current day
PreloadEdgeRemain.description_zh: 当前L1节点剩余预热数量

PreloadQuota.description_en: The remaining number of times that you can prefetch content to L1 POPs on the current day
PreloadQuota.description_zh: 当天L2节点预热数量上限

PreloadRemain.description_en: The maximum number of times that you can prefetch content to L1 nodes on the current day
PreloadRemain.description_zh: 当天L2节点剩余预热数量

RegexQuota.description_en: The maximum number of times that you can prefetch content to L2 POPs on the current day
RegexQuota.description_zh: 当天正则刷新数量上限

RegexRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be blocked on the current day
RegexRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余正则刷新数量

RequestId.description_en: The maximum number of URLs and directories that can be blocked on the current day

UrlQuota.description_en: The remaining number of directories that can be refreshed on the current day

UrlRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs or directories that can be refreshed by using regular expressions on the current day
